question: Digital lending loan ke liye borrower ko cooling-off period me exit karne ka kya provision hai?
expected_answer: Borrower cooling-off period (RE ke Board dwara decide, minimum 1 din) ke andar loan exit kar sakta hai, sirf principal + us din tak ka proportionate APR pay karke, bina kisi penalty ke. RE ek reasonable one-time processing fee retain kar sakta hai, jo KFS me disclose karna zaroori hai.
system_answer:
Digital lending loan ke liye cooling-off period mein exit karne ka provision nimnlikhit hai:

*   **Exit ka vikalp:** Borrower ko digital loan se exit karne ka spasht (explicit) vikalp diya jayega. Iske liye borrower ko sirf principal aur proportionate APR ka bhugtan karna hoga, aur koi penalty nahi li jayegi [RBI/2025-26/36::10(i)], [RBI/2022-23/111::8].
*   **Cooling-off period ki avdhi:** 
    *   Cooling-off period ka nirdharan RE (Regulated Entity) ke Board dwara unki loan policy ke anusar kiya jayega [RBI/2025-26/36::10(i)], [RBI/2022-23/111::8].
    *   Naye circular ke anusar, yeh avdhi ek din se kam nahi honi chahiye [RBI/2025-26/36::10(i)].
    *   Purane circular ke anusar, 7 din ya usse adhik ke tenor wale loans ke liye yeh avdhi 3 din se kam nahi honi chahiye, aur 7 din se kam ke tenor wale loans ke liye yeh 1 din se kam nahi honi chahiye [RBI/2022-23/111::8].
*   **Processing fee:** Agar customer cooling-off period ke dauran loan se exit karta hai, toh RE ek reasonable one-time processing fee retain kar sakta hai, agar yeh KFS (Key Fact Statement) mein pehle se disclose kiya gaya ho [RBI/2025-26/36::10(ii)].
*   **KFS mein jankari:** Cooling-off/look-up period ki jankari KFS mein honi chahiye [RBI/2022-23/111::5.2.2].

question: DLG (Default Loss Guarantee) ka maximum cap kitna hai?
expected_answer: Kisi specified loan portfolio pe total DLG cover, total disbursed amount ke 5% se zyada nahi ho sakta, kisi bhi point in time pe.
system_answer: JAWAB: DLG (Default Loss Guarantee) ka maximum cap loan portfolio ke total disbursed amount ka 5% hai [RBI/2025-26/36::23]. Implicit guarantee arrangements ke mamle mein, DLG Provider underlying loan portfolio ke 5% se zyada ka performance risk nahi utha sakta [RBI/2025-26/36::23].

question: RE ko DLG kab tak invoke karna hota hai agar loan default ho jaye?
expected_answer: RE ko DLG maximum 120 days overdue ke andar invoke karna hota hai (ya usse pehle agar borrower payment kar de).
system_answer: JAWAB: RE ko DLG, loan overdue hone ke maximum 120 din ke bheetar invoke karna hota hai, jab tak ki borrower dwara usse pehle loan dues ka bhugtan na kar diya jaye [RBI/2025-26/36::26(i)], [RBI/2023-24/41::9].

question: DLG provider kaun ban sakta hai?
expected_answer: DLG sirf LSP ke saath ya RE-jo-khud-LSP-hai ke saath enter kiya ja sakta hai, aur DLG provider Companies Act, 2013 ke under incorporated hona chahiye.
system_answer:
DLG provider banne ke liye nimnlikhit eligibility criteria hain:

*   RE (Regulated Entity) sirf ek Lending Service Provider (LSP) ya kisi doosre RE ke saath DLG arrangement kar sakti hai, jiske saath uska outsourcing (LSP) arrangement ho [RBI/2023-24/41::3-dup1].
*   DLG provide karne wale LSP ka Companies Act, 2013 ke antargat ek company ke roop mein incorporated hona anivarya hai [RBI/2025-26/36::18], [RBI/2023-24/41::3-dup1].

question: Digital lending me borrower ka data kahan store hona chahiye?
expected_answer: Saara data India me hi store hona chahiye. Agar kisi wajah se data India ke bahar process hota hai, to use 24 ghante ke andar delete karna ya India wapas laana zaroori hai.
system_answer:
Digital lending mein borrower ka data store karne ke liye RBI ke nirdesh nimnlikhit hain:

*   REs (Regulated Entities) ko yeh sunishchit karna hoga ki saara data sirf Bharat (India) mein sthit servers mein hi store kiya jaye, aur is dauran statutory obligations ya regulatory instructions ka palan kiya jaye [RBI/2022-23/111::11.4].
*   REs ko yeh bhi sunishchit karna hoga ki unke dwara engaged LSPs/DLAs borrower ki personal information store na karein, siwaye kuch basic minimal data (jaise naam, pata, contact details, aadi) ke, jo unke operations ke liye zaroori ho [RBI/2022-23/111::11.1].
*   Iske alawa, REs ko yeh sunishchit karna hoga ki unke ya unke LSPs ke DLA se jude systems mein koi bhi biometric data store ya collect na kiya jaye, jab tak ki ise extant statutory guidelines ke tahat anumati na ho [RBI/2022-23/111::11.3].

question: DLA (Digital Lending App) apps borrower ke phone se kya-kya access nahi kar sakti?
expected_answer: DLAs borrower ki file/media storage, contact list, call logs, aur telephony functions access nahi kar sakti. Camera/microphone/location ka one-time access sirf onboarding/KYC ke liye, explicit consent ke saath, allowed hai.
system_answer:
JAWAB:

Regulated Entities (REs) ko yeh sunishchit karna hoga ki unke aur unke Lending Service Providers (LSPs) ke Digital Lending Apps (DLAs) borrower ke mobile phone ke nimnlikhit resources ko access na karein:

*   File and media [RBI/2022-23/111::10], [RBI/2025-26/36::12]
*   Contact list [RBI/2022-23/111::10], [RBI/2025-26/36::12]
*   Call logs [RBI/2022-23/111::10], [RBI/2025-26/36::12]
*   Telephony functions [RBI/2022-23/111::10], [RBI/2025-26/36::12]
*   Any other similar mobile phone resources [RBI/2022-23/111::10], [RBI/2025-26/36::12]

question: Loan disbursal borrower ke account me directly hona zaroori hai ya LSP ke through bhi ho sakta hai?
expected_answer: Disbursal sirf borrower ke bank account me directly honi chahiye (statutory mandates, co-lending, ya specific end-use beneficiary cases ko chhodkar). Koi third-party ya LSP pass-through account allowed nahi hai.
system_answer:
JAWAB: Loan disbursal hamesha borrower ke bank account mein hi hona chahiye. RE (Regulated Entity) ko yeh sunishchit karna hoga ki kisi bhi sthiti mein disbursal third-party account mein na ho, jisme LSP (Lending Service Provider) aur unke DLA ke accounts bhi shamil hain [RBI/2025-26/36::9(i), RBI/2022-23/111::3].

Iske kuch apvaad (exceptions) hain:
1. Statutory ya regulatory mandate (RBI ya kisi anya regulator dwara).
2. Co-lending transactions ke dauran REs ke beech paise ka pravah.
3. Specific end-use ke liye disbursal, basharte loan seedhe end-beneficiary ke bank account mein jama kiya jaye [RBI/2025-26/36::9(i), RBI/2022-23/111::3].

question: Multi-lender LSP arrangement me offer display kab se mandatory hai aur usme kya dikhana zaroori hai?
expected_answer: 1 November 2025 se effective. Offer display me lender name(s), loan amount/tenor, APR, monthly repayment, penal charges, aur KFS ka link dikhana zaroori hai. Content unbiased aur objective hona chahiye, dark patterns allowed nahi.
system_answer:
Multi-lender LSP arrangement mein offer display ke sambandh mein niyam nimnlikhit hain:

*   **Mandatory requirement:** LSP ko borrower ki request se match karne wale sabhi loan offers ka digital view provide karna hoga [RBI/2025-26/36::6(i)].
*   **Digital view mein kya dikhana zaroori hai:**
    *   Loan offer dene wale RE(s) ka naam [RBI/2025-26/36::6(iii)].
    *   Loan ki rashi (amount) aur tenor [RBI/2025-26/36::6(iii)].
    *   APR (Annual Percentage Rate) [RBI/2025-26/36::6(iii)].
    *   Masik repayment obligation (monthly repayment obligation) [RBI/2025-26/36::6(iii)].
    *   Penal charges (yadi lagu ho) [RBI/2025-26/36::6(iii)].
    *   Har RE ke liye KFS (Key Fact Statement) ka link [RBI/2025-26/36::6(iii)].
    *   Unmatched lenders ke naam ka disclosure [RBI/2025-26/36::6(i)].

Is digital view ko is tarah se display kiya jana chahiye taaki borrower vibhinn offers ke beech fair comparison kar sake [RBI/2025-26/36::6(iii)].

question: DLA reporting RBI ke CIMS portal pe kab tak complete karni thi?
expected_answer: 15 June 2025 tak saari DLA reporting CIMS portal pe complete karni thi.
system_answer: JAWAB: RE (Regulated Entity) ko CIMS portal par sabhi DLA (Digital Lending Apps) ki reporting June 15, 2025 tak complete karni thi [RBI/2025-26/36::17(vii)].

question: Grievance redressal me complaint resolve na ho to borrower kahan escalate kar sakta hai?
expected_answer: 30 din ke andar resolve na hone ya reject hone par, borrower RBI-Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS) me escalate kar sakta hai, ya Chandigarh address pe physical complaint file kar sakta hai.
system_answer:
Agar borrower ki complaint RE (Regulated Entity) ya LSP (Lending Service Provider) dwara resolve nahi hoti hai, toh borrower niche diye gaye tareekon se escalate kar sakta hai:

*   **Complaint Management System (CMS) portal:** Borrower Reserve Bank-Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS) ke antargat CMS portal par complaint lodge kar sakta hai [RBI/2022-23/111::6.2], [RBI/2025-26/36::11.iv].
*   **Physical Complaint:** Borrower “Centralised Receipt and Processing Centre, 4th Floor, Reserve Bank of India, Sector-17, Central Vista, Chandigarh - 160017” par physical complaint bhej sakta hai [RBI/2025-26/36::11.iv].

Yeh escalation tab kiya ja sakta hai jab:
1. Complaint RE dwara puri tarah ya aanshik roop se reject kar di gayi ho [RBI/2025-26/36::11.iv].
2. Borrower RE ke jawab se santusht na ho [RBI/2025-26/36::11.iv].
3. RE ko complaint milne ke 30 dinon ke bhitar borrower ko koi jawab na mila ho [RBI/2022-23/111::6.2], [RBI/2025-26/36::11.iv].

Jin entities par RB-IOS lagu nahi hota, wahan Reserve Bank dwara nirdharit grievance redressal mechanism ke anusar complaint lodge ki ja sakti hai [RBI/2022-23/111::6.2], [RBI/2025-26/36::11.iv].

question: Credit card EMI programs is Directions ke scope me aate hain kya?
expected_answer: Nahi. Credit card EMI programs 21 April 2022 ke Master Direction se governed hote hain, is 2025 Directions ke scope se bahar hain. Baaki card-based loans is Directions me cover hote hain.
system_answer:
JAWAB: Nahi, Credit Card EMI programmes is Directions ke scope mein nahi aate hain. 

Credit Card EMI programmes vishesh roop se 'Master Direction on Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct, 2022' ke Para 6(b)(iii) dwara govern kiye jaate hain aur ye transactions in Directions ke antargat cover nahi hote hain [RBI/2025-26/36::29]. 

Halanki, Credit Card par offer kiye jaane wale anya loan products jo uparyukt para mein cover nahi hote, ve in Directions ke adheen honge [RBI/2025-26/36::29].

question: RE ko borrower ki creditworthiness assess karte waqt automatic credit limit increase allowed hai kya?
expected_answer: Nahi, borrower ki explicit aur recorded request ke bina automatic credit limit increase prohibited hai.
system_answer: JAWAB: Nahi, RE ko automatic credit limit increase ki anumati nahi hai. RE ko yeh sunishchit karna hoga ki credit limit mein koi bhi automatic badhotri na ho, jab tak ki borrower se iske liye spasht anurodh (explicit request) prapt na ho, uska mulyankan na kiya gaya ho aur use record par na rakha gaya ho [RBI/2025-26/36::7]. Iske alawa, RE ko yeh bhi sunishchit karna hoga ki aisi har badhotri ke liye borrower ki spasht sahamati (explicit consent) record par li jaye [RBI/2022-23/111::7].

question: DLG arrangement ke through NBFC-P2P (peer-to-peer lending) enter kar sakti hai kya?
expected_answer: Nahi, NBFC-P2P DLG arrangement me existing P2P Master Direction ke tehat enter nahi kar sakti.
system_answer:
JAWAB:

Nahi, NBFC-P2P DLG arrangements mein enter nahi kar sakti. RBI circular ke anusar, NBFC-P2P apne platform par facilitate kiye gaye loans ke liye DLG arrangements mein enter nahi kar sakti aur unhe 'Master Direction - Non-Banking Financial Company – Peer to Peer Lending Platform (Reserve Bank) Directions, 2017' ke para 6(1)(iv) ka palan karna hoga [RBI/2025-26/36::20(iii)].

question: DLG kis form me accept kiya ja sakta hai?
expected_answer: Teen forms accepted hain: cash RE ke paas rakha hua, fixed deposit (scheduled bank me, RE ke favour me lien ke saath), ya bank guarantee RE ke favour me.
system_answer:
JAWAB:

RE (Regulated Entity) DLG ko sirf neeche diye gaye forms mein accept kar sakta hai:

*   RE ke paas jama ki gayi cash [RBI/2025-26/36::22], [RBI/2023-24/41::5].
*   Scheduled Commercial Bank mein rakhi gayi Fixed Deposit, jis par RE ke favour mein lien mark ho [RBI/2025-26/36::22], [RBI/2023-24/41::5].
*   RE ke favour mein Bank Guarantee [RBI/2025-26/36::22], [RBI/2023-24/41::5].

question: 2025 Directions ne kaunse teen purane circulars ko repeal kiya?
expected_answer: 24 June 2020 ka circular (digital lending fair practices), 2 September 2022 ke Guidelines on Digital Lending, aur 8 June 2023 ke DLG Guidelines — teeno repeal ho gaye. In repealed circulars ke tehat pehle liye gaye actions/penalties valid rahenge agar naye Directions se consistent hain.
system_answer:
Pata nahi — is corpus me iska jawab available nahi hai. 

CONTEXT [RBI/2025-26/36::30] ke mutabik, 2025 Directions ke jari hone par Annex-III me ullekhit circulars repeal ho gaye hain, lekin diye gaye CONTEXT me Annex-III ki list khali hai aur usme kisi bhi circular ka naam ya sankhya (number) nahi di gayi hai.

question: 2025 Directions me aisa kya naya hai jo 2022 ki Guidelines on Digital Lending me nahi tha?
expected_answer: 2025 Directions me naye additions hain: Para 6 (multi-lender LSP arrangements me offer matching/transparency), Para 17 (CIMS portal pe DLA directory reporting), Para 10 (cooling-off period), aur Paras 12-14 me comprehensive data/privacy provisions. Ye 2022 Guidelines me is form me nahi the — 2025 Directions inhe naya add karti hain, purani teeno circulars ko consolidate karte hue.
source_document: RBI (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025 (Para 1 preamble + Para 30 repeal provisions)
system_answer:
2025 Directions mein kuch naye measures shamil kiye gaye hain jo pehle ki guidelines mein nahi the:

1. Lending Service Providers (LSPs) ke liye aise arrangements jo multiple regulated entities ke saath partnership karte hain [RBI/2025-26/36::1].
2. Digital lending apps ki directory banane ka pravdhan [RBI/2025-26/36::1].

question: DLG guidelines (2023) aur 2025 Directions ke DLG chapter me kya continuity hai?
expected_answer: 2025 Directions ka Chapter VI, 2023 ki DLG Guidelines ko comprehensively restate karta hai — 5% cap clarify hui (illustrations ke saath), aur 120-day invocation timeline retain hui hai. Detailed clause-by-clause fark verify karne ke liye 2023 ki guidelines ka original text chahiye — wo abhi humare corpus me exact citation ke saath available nahi hai, sirf 2025 Directions ka apna summary hai.
system_answer:
JAWAB:

DLG guidelines (2023) aur 2025 Directions ke beech continuity ka vivaran niche diya gaya hai:

*   RBI/2023-24/41, jo ki 08.06.2023 ko jari ki gayi thi, wahi 'Guidelines on Default Loss Guarantee (DLG) in Digital Lending' hai [RBI/2025-26/36::3-dup1].
*   DLG arrangements ke liye customer protection aur grievance redressal ke mamle 02 September 2022 ki 'Guidelines on Digital Lending' aur anya lagu niyam ke anusar hi chalenge [RBI/2023-24/41::13].
*   DLG ki paribhasha aur uske structure se sambandhit niyam, jaise ki legally enforceable contract aur usme shamil hone wali jankariyan (extent of cover, timeline, etc.), 2023 ke circular mein nirdharit hain [RBI/2023-24/41::2-dup1], [RBI/2023-24/41::4-dup1].

question: 2020 ke circular (Loans Sourced by Banks & NBFCs over Digital Lending Platforms) ka kya status hai ab?
expected_answer: Ye circular (RBI/2019-20/258, 24 June 2020) 2025 Directions dwara repeal ho chuka hai — ab operative nahi hai.
system_answer: Pata nahi — is corpus me iska jawab available nahi hai.

question: LSP ko RE ke bina consent ke fees kaun deta hai — RE ya borrower?
expected_answer: LSP ki fees RE directly deti hai. Borrower se ye fee charge nahi ki ja sakti.
system_answer: JAWAB: LSP ko fees, charges, ya reimbursements ka bhugtan (payment) seedhe RE (Regulated Entity) dwara kiya jana chahiye. LSP ko yeh anumati nahi hai ki woh borrower se alag se koi fees ya charges vasule [RBI/2025-26/36::9(iv)], [RBI/2022-23/111::4.1].

question: Cash recovery ke case me (delinquent loans), kya recovery amount RE ke account me directly jaana zaroori hai?
expected_answer: Cash recovery ko direct-account requirement se exempt kiya gaya hai, par usi din RE ke account me reflect hona chahiye. LSP ki recovery fee RE khud deti hai, proceeds se deduct nahi hoti.
system_answer:
JAWAB: Nahi, delinquent loans ke mamle mein cash recovery ke liye RE ko operational flexibility di gayi hai, jiske tahat ye transactions RE ke bank account mein seedhe repayment ki requirement se exempted hain [RBI/2025-26/36::9(v)]. 

Halanki, RE ko ye sunishchit karna hoga ki:
1. Cash mein ki gayi koi bhi recovery usi din borrower ke account mein poori tarah reflect ho [RBI/2025-26/36::9(v)].
2. LSP ko aisi recovery ke liye jo bhi fees ya charges dene hain, wo RE dwara seedhe diye jayenge aur LSP dwara borrower se direct ya indirect roop se vasool nahi kiye jayenge [RBI/2025-26/36::9(v)].

question: DLG disclosure requirements ke tehat LSP ko kitni baar aur kya publish karna hota hai?
expected_answer: LSP ko monthly, month-end ke 7 working days ke andar, total portfolio number aur respective amounts publish karne hote hain jahan DLG offer ki gayi hai. RE ka naam disclose karna optional hai.
system_answer:
DLG disclosure requirements ke tehat LSP ko apni website par nimnlikhit jaankari publish karni hoti hai:

*   **Kya publish karna hai:** LSP ko total number of portfolios aur har us portfolio ki respective amount publish karni hoti hai jis par DLG offer kiya gaya hai [RBI/2025-26/36::27(i)], [RBI/2023-24/41::11].
*   **Kitni baar publish karna hai:** Yeh disclosure monthly basis par ki jani chahiye [RBI/2025-26/36::27(ii)].
*   **Timeline:** Kisi bhi mahine ke liye disclosure us mahine ke khatam hone ke baad 7 working days ke bheetar provide ki jani chahiye [RBI/2025-26/36::27(ii)].
